rationale: Cribl's official product documentation lists AI capabilities across Cribl products, including a Copilot Editor to create/edit Stream pipelines, Guard model-based detection and Search assistants; the suite documentation also identifies Cribl Stream and Edge. Thus the combined Edge and Stream offering is AI-enabled while retaining conventional data-pipeline and telemetry collection functions. AI provider availability/configuration and record-version timing remain materially uncertain, so the call is weak/forced.
ai_type_rationale: The record's Stream/Edge core is a telemetry collection, transformation, and routing pipeline that remains meaningful without assistants; AI tools enhance that core. Product/version applicability and deployment configuration remain uncertain.
version_scope: Record has no release/date. Current Cribl AI documentation covers the current product suite; some features require provider configuration and some AI features may postdate the source-record version.
issues: AI features depend on deployment/provider state; do not assume every deployment has functioning AI capability.
Undated record may precede current Cribl AI feature availability.
